caption: The drawing features two views of a single porcelain plate against a cream-colored background. The top section of the image shows the plate from above, displaying a round form with a slightly scalloped edge. The surface is decorated in blue with a symmetrical floral pattern consisting of stylized flowers, leaves, and curving vines evenly distributed around the plate. The lower section of the image presents a side view of the same plate, illustrating its shallow depth and the slight outward curve of its rim, which also has a fine blue outline. The plate is depicted primarily in white, accented with various shades of blue for the decorative details and edge. There is a small signature or inscription in the lower right-hand corner of the drawing.
title: Saucer
